name: W3C AI Agent Protocol Community Group
status: Active Community Group (created 2025-05-08); agent identity is DID-method-agnostic (did:wba, did:web, did:webvh) since 2026-08-13. Bi-weekly meetings; the meeting of 2026-10-07 was announced as canceled (calendar notice of 2026-10-01) and the October 2026 list archive holds 5 messages, the last of 2026-10-07, none announcing a later meeting (read 2026-10-13); the W3C group data list two chairs.
relevance: The protocol draft defines an Agent Discovery Service Protocol in JSON-LD, with active discovery at https://{domain}/.well-known/agent-descriptions and an Agent Description "Information" that covers "products, or services". The use_case.html draft includes a hotel booking scenario (Personal Agent, Search Agent, hotel Service Agent) with the requirement "Agent Transactions". The agent identity draft uses a Decentralized Identifier (DID) URL as the HTTP signature keyid with RFC 9421 and RFC 9530.

committed_next.what: Topics "streaming HTTP authentication, mutual DID authentication"; joint Technical Plenary and Advisory Committee (TPAC) session with the WebAgents Community Group (CG) under discussion

boundary: On 2026-09-10 the maintainer wrote of a proposal on agent memory "My feeling is that this goes beyond the current scope of our protocol.".
